summary.one_liner: Airbrush is a phone-based AI photo and video editing app for retouching portraits, fixing lighting, removing distractions, and extending or stylizing photos.
use_cases: remove people or objects from photos
blur backgrounds to make a subject stand out
extend a photo beyond its original frame
apply face and body edits to videos
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Airbrush as a mobile app for editing photos and videos. Its AI Retouch, makeup, and skin tools smooth skin and brighten details while aiming to keep the look natural. Lighting effects such as brighter, softer, warmer, or atmospheric looks can be applied to photos. Cleanup tools remove mirror marks, background clutter, passersby, or unwanted objects, and AI can swap objects or areas. Other listed features include expanding the frame, soft background blur, fixing blurry or damaged areas, artistic light effects, and face and body editing for video.
